categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production and sales of high-efficiency heat exchangers. Main products include high-efficiency shell-and-tube heat exchangers, coaxial tube-in-tube heat exchangers, falling film heat exchangers, evaporative condensers, liquid cooling radiators and distributors. These products serve as core components in heat pumps and air conditioning systems, with applications in heating, hot water supply, refrigeration, and agricultural/industrial production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies in heat exchanger product design, manufacturing processes, and analytical testing. Key technologies include multi-head spiral tube structures with serrated high-efficiency tubes, distributor refrigerant distribution technology, integrated distributor-collector-heat exchanger structures, and U-bend processing and welding techniques. The company employs standardized and modular design for batch production, with advanced manufacturing equipment and quality control systems including ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO45001, UL and ASME certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major domestic and international air conditioning and heat pump manufacturers including Haier, Midea, Gree, Daikin, Hitachi, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Carrier, Trane, and McQuay. Primary end markets include commercial air conditioning systems, residential heat pump systems, industrial heating applications, and data center cooling systems. The company's top five customers account for 57.77% of annual sales revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Anji County, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province. It has a subsidiary, Xinchang Jingxin Precision Machinery Parts Co., Ltd., located in Xinchang County, Shaoxing. Domestic sales represent 99.64% of revenue, with minimal international operations (0.36% of revenue). The company serves customers throughout China and has limited export business.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream/component manufacturing segment of the heat pump and air conditioning industry. It manufactures critical heat exchange components that are supplied to downstream original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) who produce complete heat pump and air conditioning systems. The company sources raw materials (copper, aluminum, steel) from upstream suppliers and sells finished heat exchangers to major system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on developing high-efficiency, energy-saving heat exchanger products aligned with China's carbon neutrality goals. R&D priorities include improving heat transfer efficiency, developing products for low-temperature heat pump applications, expanding into new product categories (plate heat exchangers, evaporative condensers), and enhancing performance for emerging applications like data center cooling. The company collaborates with universities including Xi'an Jiaotong University and Shanghai Jiaotong University on advanced heat transfer research.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured heat exchanger products to OEM customers (96.92% of sales). A smaller portion comes from indirect sales through distributors (3.08%). Revenue is recognized when customers take control of products, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company operates on a made-to-order basis with customized products for specific customer applications.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic heat exchanger manufacturer competing with both international and domestic suppliers. Major competitors include international companies like Daikin, Carrier, and Trane, as well as domestic manufacturers. The company differentiates through superior product quality, technical innovation, and strong relationships with major OEM customers. It holds leading market share in shell-and-tube and tube-in-tube heat exchanger segments within China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company generated revenue of 567.1 million yuan in 2023 (essentially flat vs. 566.6 million in 2022). Net profit attributable to shareholders was 101.2 million yuan in 2023 (down 3.74% from 105.1 million in 2022). Total assets grew significantly to 1.43 billion yuan at year-end 2023 from 541.9 million yuan in 2022, primarily due to IPO proceeds. The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in May 2023, raising 887.8 million yuan in net proceeds.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes superior heat transfer efficiency, product reliability, and customized solutions. Key differentiators include proprietary high-efficiency tube designs, innovative distributor technology that ensures uniform refrigerant distribution, modular standardized designs enabling efficient production, and comprehensive quality certifications. The company positions itself as a technology leader providing solutions that help customers meet energy efficiency standards and carbon reduction targets, with strong technical support and after-sales service.
